text:
maria: Heads up — saw a token scope fallthrough in prod. Token with embeddings-only scope succeeded on /v1/chat.generate. I spotted this in the audit stream and did a quick repro.
sec-bot: [automated] alert: scope_mismatch detected for token tkn-xxxx at 2026-03-19T22:30:12Z. route=/v1/chat.generate, token_scopes=[embeddings:create], outcome=allowed
chris: Ugh. Do we have a full log line and request payload? Can you paste the audit event?
maria: Pasting redacted log snippet: 
```\n{"ts":"2026-03-19T22:30:12Z","actor":"token:tkn-xxxx","action":"call_model","route":"/v1/chat.generate","model":"gpt-small-v1","token_scopes":["embeddings:create"],"decision":"ALLOW","enforcer_version":"v1.12.3"}\n```
alex: That decision should have been DENY. Two quick possibilities: 1) enforcement lookup fell back to an old scope-mapping table during KMS key rotation, 2) a route alias got registered that maps chat -> embeddings handler.
jamal: We rotated the KMS key for scope-mapping config at 22:25Z. There were transient failures fetching the mapping cache for ~20s. Could be related.
chris: Can you repro locally with the same token? If it's a deterministic fallback bug we should be able to hit it. Also: what's the short-term mitigation — revoke the token?
maria: I repro'ed with a curl request using the token: 
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer tkn-xxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small-v1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}] }'\n```
Response: 200 with model output.
sec-bot: [automated] policy-cache: cache_miss for scope-mapping key cfg/scopes/global -> fetching from KMS endpoint, status=500 (22:25:06Z)
alex: OK, root cause hypothesis: during KMS rotation the policy service returned an empty mapping and the enforcer used legacy permissive fallback for backward compatibility. That fallback path lacks per-route scope checks.
chris: If that's true we need an immediate guard: change fallback -> FAIL_CLOSED not FAIL_OPEN. Short patch and hotfix to the enforcer binary.
maria: Agreed. I already revoked tkn-xxxx and queued a revocation roll for matching tokens (search by policy_id). But we have customers with long-lived API keys — need to identify impacted keys by querying audit logs for any "decision":"ALLOW" where token_scopes does not cover route type.
jamal: I'll run a query against the audit index and post a list. Expect to take ~15m.
sre-oncall: Also escalate to incident channel? This is a security-sensitive scope leak. Open an incident; severity P1 until we confirm blast radius.
chris: I'll draft the incident postmortem template and owner list. Steps: 1) hotfix enforcer fallback (chris), 2) deploy hotfix to prod (eng-oncall), 3) audit & revoke impacted tokens (maria/jamal), 4) add test to CI to simulate KMS failures and assert FAIL_CLOSED (alex), 5) extended audit retention + alerting on scope mismatch (sec-team).
alex: Quick patch in enforcer: change get_scope_mapping() fallback: if mapping==null -> throw EnforcementError -> DENY. This is ~6 lines. I'll open PR labeled security-hotfix.
maria: I'm attaching the minimal repro and the redacted audit query I used: 
```\nPOST /_search
{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ {"match": {"action":"call_model"}}, {"term": {"decision":"ALLOW"}}, {"script": {"script":"!params._source.token_scopes.contains(params.route_required)", "params":{"route_required":"chat:generate"}} } ] } } }\n```
sec-bot: [automated] ticket created: SEC-4821 "RBAC fallback allowed chat calls for embeddings-only tokens"
chris: Assigning owners: chris (hotfix & deploy), alex (PR + CI test), jamal (audit query & token list), maria (revocations & customer notifications), sre-oncall (deploy coordination).
maria: I'll prepare a short customer-safe notification draft and share in #support before sending.
jamal: Audit run done — found 12 distinct tokens, 8 active API keys, 3 service accounts. Posting IDs to SEC-4821.
chris: After hotfix, we should also add a read-only endpoint to surface current effective scope mappings and last KMS fetch time for troubleshooting.
alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/enforcer/pull/492 — tag=security-hotfix. CI green locally.
sre-oncall: Deploying enforcer v1.12.4-hotfix to canary now. Rolling to prod after 15m verification.
maria: Thanks everyone. Once prod is verified let's close incident and run a short postmortem focusing on KMS rotation SLOs, fallback policy, and auditing gaps.
chris: Agreed. Add action item to restrict future KMS rotations to maintenance windows unless hot-path resilience is validated. :+1:
